title: Zechariah's prophecy about the king on a donkey
description: The prophet Zechariah proclaims that the king of Jerusalem will come riding on a donkey, humble and righteous, bringing peace to the nations—a prophecy fulfilled at Jesus' entry into Jerusalem.
